title: George and Job
statementMd:
The new ITone 6 has been released recently and George got really keen to buy it. Unfortunately, he didn't have enough money, so George was going to work as a programmer. Now he faced the following problem at the work.

Given a sequence of $*n*$ integers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$. You are to choose $*k*$ pairs of integers:

$[*l*_{1}, *r*_{1}], [*l*_{2}, *r*_{2}], ..., [*l*_{*k*}, *r*_{*k*}] (1 ≤ *l*_{1} ≤ *r*_{1} < *l*_{2} ≤ *r*_{2} < ... < *l*_{*k*} ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*; *r*_{*i*} - *l*_{*i*} + 1 = *m*),$

in such a way that the value of sum ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/56a872d240fd0705aaee49aa3763026a40df8f6c.png) is maximal possible. Help George to cope with the task.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*k*$ $(1 ≤ (*m* × *k*) ≤ *n* ≤ 5000)$. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ $(0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

Print an integer in a single line — the maximum possible value of sum.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

最近，新款 ITone 6 发布了，George 非常想买一部。不幸的是，他没有足够的钱，因此 George 打算成为一名程序员。现在，他在工作中遇到了如下问题。

给定一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$。你需要选择 $*k*$ 个整数区间：

$[*l*_{1}, *r*_{1}], [*l*_{2}, *r*_{2}], ..., [*l*_{*k*}, *r*_{*k*}] (1 ≤ *l*_{1} ≤ *r*_{1} < *l*_{2} ≤ *r*_{2} < ... < *l*_{*k*} ≤ *r*_{*k*} ≤ *n*; *r*_{*i*} - *l*_{*i*} + 1 = *m*)$，

使得和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/56a872d240fd0705aaee49aa3763026a40df8f6c.png) 的值尽可能大。请帮助 George 完成这项任务。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*k*$ $(1 ≤ (*m* × *k*) ≤ *n* ≤ 5000)$。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ $(0 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数，表示和的最大可能值。
